properties.summary: Mobile-first responsive design. Content-driven breakpoints. Non-negotiable renders at 320px 375px 414px 768px. Principles for min-width queries, breakpoints, fluid scaling via clamp(), pointer/hover queries, clickable text never wraps, viewport units (dvh/svh/lvh), safe areas, tables collapse, images with srcset.
non_negotiable: overflow-x clip on html and body
